name: trackiq-amazon-daily-snacks-email
title: TrackIQ: Amazon Daily Snacks Email
summary: A three-minute editorial daily email for an Amazon account — one lead story with a takeaway, quick bites, a scoreboard, charts and a to-do list.
changelog: Replaces the bundled sample data with a fictional demo brand shared with the weekly report.
fallback: Works from figures pasted into the chat when the TrackIQ MCP is not connected.

delivery.note: in-chat always works and is the fallback. file needs a filesystem, n8n needs network, slack and email need their tool connected. Outward sends confirm first.
